commands.ghost scan:
Create a Ghost scan with feature candidates discovered from repository analysis (optionally deepened by a multi-perspective fan-out of read-only analysis lenses to raise recall). Candidates are created in 'pending' review status for user approval. Populate detectedSourceFiles, detectedTestFiles, and detectedDocFiles per candidate - tests and docs are first-class scan data, linked on apply. Schema: --candidates [{"slug":"...","title":"...","description":"...","componentSlug":"<component-slug>","confidenceScore":<0-1>,"detectedTestFiles":["<path>"],"detectedSourceFiles":["<path>"],"detectedDocFiles":["<path>"],"priority":"critical|high|medium|low","estimatedEffort":"S|M|L|XL","securityClassification":"public|internal|confidential|restricted","sourceFileAnalyses":[...]}], --components [{"slug":"...","name":"...","description":"..."}]. Every candidate needs slug and title. On apply, a candidate that creates a feature needs componentSlug; a component the product lacks is created, named from its --components entry when there is one.

Usage:
  zensu ghost scan [flags]

Flags:
      --branch string          branch name
      --candidates string      JSON array of candidate objects; each "description" is Markdown (required unless --candidates-file)
      --candidates-file path   read the --candidates JSON from path, or - for stdin (max 4 MiB)
      --components string      optional JSON array of component objects; each "description" is Markdown
      --components-file path   read the --components JSON from path, or - for stdin (max 4 MiB)
  -h, --help                   help for scan
      --json                   output raw JSON
      --product string         product ID (required)
      --repo-url string        repository URL
      --source string          scan source: api, mcp, or web_ui (default "api")

Global Flags:
      --api-url string   Zensu API base URL (overrides stored host and ZENSU_API_URL)

commands.wiki create:
Create a new wiki page for a product. Wiki pages store documentation content such as user-facing guides, API references, internal docs, and release notes. The command never changes an existing page. The server derives the new page's path from the title, or for a feature-linked page from the feature and the doc type, for example /custom/<slug of the title> or /features/<feature slug>/<doc type>. When a page already exists at that path, the command fails, names that page's path and id and leaves it unchanged; `zensu wiki update <page-id>` changes an existing page. The check needs Zensu backend v0.89.2 and wiki v0.15.1 or later; an older server ignores it and updates the existing page instead.

Use local static PNG, JPEG or WebP files only; remote URLs are not fetched.
The server sanitizes uploads and returns reference=wiki-asset:<uuid>.
Insert ![Alternative text](wiki-asset:<uuid> "Optional caption"){width=50%} into Markdown.
Omit the width for automatic sizing, or use 1–100% or 1–4096px; height is proportional.
Keep the reference in the same product and explicitly save the page (private by default).
Uploading alone never publishes; unused uploads expire after 30 days.

Usage:
  zensu wiki create [flags]

Flags:
      --audience string      target audience (end_user|developer|admin|internal)
      --content string       page content in markdown (required unless --content-file)
      --content-file path    read the --content value from path, or - for stdin (max 256 KiB)
      --doc-type string      document type (user_facing|api_reference|tutorial|adr|release_notes|internal|migration_guide|overview)
      --entity-id string     entity UUID to link the page to
      --entity-type string   entity type to link (feature|component|product)
  -h, --help                 help for create
      --json                 output raw JSON
      --product string       product UUID (required)
      --title string         page title (required)
      --visibility string    page visibility: public|private (defaults to private)

Global Flags:
      --api-url string   Zensu API base URL (overrides stored host and ZENSU_API_URL)
